blocks.text: Collingwood Neighbourhood School (3417 Euclid Ave) is a school in Collingwood. This is not a complete list of the schools nearby.

Living near a school does not mean a place at it. Your child's school comes from the district's catchment boundaries, and those change, so confirm the address with the district before you write an offer.
Source: BC Ministry of Education and Child Care school list (2025/26, updated July 2026) and the Province's post-secondary locations list. Neighbourhood placement is from our own area research.

faq.q: Is Collingwood an official City of Vancouver area?
faq.a: Not on its own — the City's official local area is Renfrew-Collingwood, one of its 22 distinct areas; "Collingwood" is the locality and board short name used for this page, and the City's plans and station work all use Renfrew-Collingwood.

faq.q: Which schools are located in the area?
faq.a: Three VSB elementaries — Nootka (3375 Nootka Street), John Norquay (4710 Slocan Street) and Renfrew (3315 East 22nd Avenue) — and Windermere Secondary, 3155 East 27th Avenue; catchments are address-based, so check the exact address in the VSB locator.

faq.q: What plans are changing this area?
faq.a: The Joyce-Collingwood Station Precinct Plan guides change around Joyce Station, and the Rupert and Renfrew Station Area Plan — approved by Council in July 2025 — covers the Millennium Line station areas at the north side, on top of the Renfrew-Collingwood Community Vision.

faq.q: What is Renfrew Ravine and Still Creek?
faq.a: Renfrew Ravine Park, 3900 Renfrew Street, is a 5.89-hectare natural park through which Still Creek runs — one of the few remaining salmon-bearing streams in Vancouver, whose floodplain is part of the City's designated floodplain dataset.
